requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity — discussed diet and exercise; patient will try to cut portions and walk more. Revisit at next visit.
2. Hypertension: BP 126/89 on lisinopril 10 mg daily; continue.
3. Anxiety — stable on sertraline.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 05/20/2026
Self-referred through clinic for weight management. Patient reports no prior structured diet or exercise plan; this is his first formal nutrition counseling. Food log: restaurant meals most days, sweet tea and soda, late snacks.
Plan: Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie diet, cutting sugar-sweetened drinks, target ~1400 kcal/day; cook at home 4 nights; water aerobics / lap swimming 3 times a week (shoulder-friendly per ortho).
RD follow-up in 6–8 weeks.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 07/15/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, no sugar-sweetened drinks. Small adjustments to snack portions and restaurant choices.
Reports keeping up with swimming/water aerobics about 3 times a week.
Continue plan.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/10/2026
S: 41 y/o M, follow-up weight and BP. Has completed 8 months of dedicated diet and exercise efforts since around the new year. Weight 90.9 kg today, minimal change. Asks about Wegovy. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 90.9 kg, BMI 35.5. BP 129/85.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 35.5 — Plan: start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hypertension: BP 129/85 on lisinopril 10 mg daily; continue.
